items.source: Returns a ExposureConfigurer to allow the registration of type specific ExposureConfigurer.AggregateResourceHttpMethodsFilter and ExposureConfigurer.AssociationResourceHttpMethodsFilters which means the configured filters will only be invoked for aggregates of the given type and properties owned by that type respectively.
items.translation: 返回一个 ExposureConfigurer，以允许注册特定类型的 ExposureConfigurer.AggregateResourceHttpMethodsFilter 和 ExposureConfigurer.AssociationResourceHttpMethodsFilter，这意味着配置的过滤器将仅针对给定类型的聚合以及该类型所拥有的属性分别进行调用。

items.source: Disables the ability to create new item resources via HttpMethod.PUT.
items.translation: 禁用通过 HttpMethod.PUT 创建新项资源的能力。
注册给定的ExposureConfigurer.AssociationResourceHttpMethodsFilter。

items.source: Registers the given ExposureConfigurer.AggregateResourceHttpMethodsFilter to be used for collection resources.
items.translation: 注册给定的ExposureConfigurer.AggregateResourceHttpMethodsFilter，用于集合资源。

items.source: Registers the given ExposureConfigurer.AggregateResourceHttpMethodsFilter to be used for item resources.
items.translation: 注册给定的ExposureConfigurer.AggregateResourceHttpMethodsFilter，用于项目资源。

items.source: Configuration type to register filters customizing the HTTP methods supported.
items.translation: 用于注册自定义过滤器以支持特定 HTTP 方法的配置类型。

items.source: Uses of ExposureConfigurer in org.springframework.data.rest.core.mapping
items.translation: ExposureConfigurer 在 org.springframework.data.rest.core.mapping 包中的用途
